commit.subject: watchdog: make cache accounting incremental
commit.body:
Maintain a conservative aggregate from individually measured entries and bounded container metadata, so eviction no longer traverses the retained cache on every update. Reuse unchanged compact projections while preserving re-cache after eviction and mutation scans.

Source: original
Co-Authored-By: GPT-5.6 Sol <noreply@openai.com>
